abstract: BACKGROUND: A common genetic feature of neuroblastomas, which is also an important prognostic factor, is deletion of chromosome region 1p. The deletion of 1p often involves a deletion of varying size, with a consensus region within the most distal bands 1p36.2-3. The neuroblastoma SRO (shortest region of overlap of (deletions) presented earlier by our group was defined distally by the cluster of loci D1S80/ D1Z2/CDC2L1 and proximally by loci D1S244, i.e., approximately 25 cM. The 1p deletions are, however, not restricted to neuroblastoma tumours. In fact, a large spectrum of tumour types display deletions to varying degrees of 1p. PROCEDURE: We have exploited the possibility of using deletions of other tumour types, preferentially that of germ cell tumours, and combining the deletions with that of the neuroblastoma SRO. Also in germ cell tumours, distal 1p-deletions have been shown to have prognostic significance. RESULTS: We found in our germ cell tumours a SRO ranging from D1S508 to D1S200. Interestingly, this region only partially overlapped (approximately 5 cm) with our neuroblastoma SRO in region D1S508 to D1S244. We have thus focused on analysing this smaller region in the search for genes involved in the genesis of different cancers. We have performed radiation hybrid mapping of a large number of markers, STSs, ESTs, and others known to reside in 1p. We have also initiated the development of a BAC contig of the region. FISH, and fibre-FISH mapping of BACs were also performed. CONCLUSIONS: The data presented here constitute an ongoing work with the aim of identifying and cloning gene(s) important for development of germ cell tumours, neuroblastomas, and possibly other tumours.
abstract_ja: 背景:神経芽腫に共通する遺伝学的特徴は、予後因子ともなる第1染色体短腕(1p)の欠失である。1p欠失は大きさがさまざまで、遠位の1p36.2-3に最も共通する領域がある。我々が以前報告した神経芽腫の最短重複領域(SRO)は、遠位側をD1S80/D1Z2/CDC2L1のマーカー群、近位側をD1S244で規定され、約25 cMであった。しかし1p欠失は神経芽腫に限らず、多くの腫瘍型で程度の差はあれ認められる。手順:他の腫瘍型、特に胚細胞腫瘍の欠失を利用し、それを神経芽腫のSROと組み合わせることを検討した。胚細胞腫瘍でも1p遠位欠失が予後に関連することが示されている。結果:胚細胞腫瘍では、D1S508からD1S200までのSROを見いだした。この領域は神経芽腫のSRO(D1S508からD1S244)と約5 cMのみ部分的に重なっていた。そこで、より小さなこの領域の解析に焦点を絞った。多数のマーカー(STS、EST等)について放射線ハイブリッドマッピングを行い、この領域のBACコンティグの構築も開始した。FISHおよびファイバーFISHによりBACをマッピングした。結論:本研究は進行中の研究であり、胚細胞腫瘍、神経芽腫、そしておそらく他の腫瘍の発生に関与する遺伝子を同定し、クローニングすることを目的としている。
